text:
Marta G: heads-up — got a sticky pager from the customer-facing kv-cache last 10m, high error-rate on small subset of keys. tagging primary.

incident-bot: Pager alert: KV-CACHE-STALL prod-east severity: P1. Affected service: api-ingest. Pager triggered by 5xx spike (>80% for 3m).

Alex T: i'm primary for this window — grabbing it. quick status: metrics show elevated latencies and TCP retries to node pool kv-prod-3.

Priya S: any recent deploys?

Alex T: no deploys in the last hour. autoscale events noted but nothing that should affect KV. seeing memory pressure on kv-prod-3 and a bunch of LRU evictions.

DevOps Carl: can you try evicting that node from service and let it warm up? command: `./infra/remove-node --pool kv-prod --node kv-prod-3 --drain` then `kubectl rollout restart deployment/kv-cache` in prod-east.

Alex T: doing drain now, will re-route traffic.

SRE Oncall: adding checklist from runbook (putting here for quick ref): 1) Confirm customer impact (+ which routes) 2) Drain affected node 3) Restart kv workers 4) Check prefix cache hit rates 5) Escalate to infra if disk io or oom observed. Runbooks: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-stall, https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pager-playbook, https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollout-fallback

Priya S: customer impact: internal incident page shows API /v1/generate error rate >50% for the affected tenant (tenants: acme-corp). reaching out to SE for notification.

Alex T: drain complete, taking node out of LB. restarting kv-cache workers:```bash
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deployment/kv-cache
# watch pods
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=kv-cache -w
```

incident-bot: Action recorded: node kv-prod-3 drained by Alex T.

Alex T: pods coming back up but one pod in CrashLoopBackOff — pulling logs.```bash
kubectl -n prod logs kv-cache-7f6b9 -c kv-cache | tail -n 200
# shows repeated OOMKilled and goroutine dump referencing compaction
```

DevOps Carl: OOMs point to memory leak under specific key churn. Workaround: increase pod memory to 8Gi temporarily and set `CACHE_MAX_KEYS=2e6` to reduce memory usage. Apply with `kubectl set env deployment/kv-cache CACHE_MAX_KEYS=2000000` and patch resources.

Priya S: suggested messaging to SE: "We observed a partial outage for API /v1/generate for Acme customers due to backend key-value cache instability. We've drained the affected node, restarted services, and applied a temporary memory increase. We're monitoring and will follow up with root cause and ETA for permanent fix."

Alex T: applied env change and bumped memory on the deployment. new pods are stable. error rate dropped from 52% -> 4% over last 60s.

SRE Oncall: nice work. quick post-handoff checklist before I go: - document node id + logs in incident ticket - schedule deeper memprof run on kv-cache-7f6b9 image - create canary test for churn keys - follow runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-stall#postmortem-guidance

Marta G: i'm taking the handoff in 15m. Alex, leave a short note in the ticket with `what changed`, `cmds run`, `next steps`. Priya, pls confirm customer notification status.

Alex T: note added to INC-4321: drained kv-prod-3, restarted kv-cache, bumped pod memory to 8Gi, set CACHE_MAX_KEYS=2e6. pending: memprof + code review on compaction loop.

Priya S: SE pinged and ACME notified. they acknowledged and are doing smoke tests.

SRE Oncall: final quick links for handoff: runbook (same): https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-stall, playbook gem: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pager-playbook#quick-remedies, rlz fallback: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollout-fallback. Also command snippet to rollback env quickly: `kubectl -n prod set env deployment/kv-cache CACHE_MAX_KEYS-` (removes) and `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/kv-cache` if needed.

Marta G: thanks. i'll monitor for 30m and escalate if any regressions. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident INC-4321 updated: status -> monitoring, primary -> Marta G, secondary -> Alex T.

Alex T: leaving logs and next steps in ticket, standing by for any escalation.

Marta G: handing over now — cover until 23:00 UTC. if pager fires again, follow the runbook steps above and ping #eng-sre for infra assist.

Priya S: copy, thanks team.

DevOps Carl: real RCA follow-up candidates: compaction path review, memory guardrails, and a targeted canary for high-churn keysets.

SRE Oncall: added tasks to INC-4321. closing thread in slack, continue in ticket. :white_check_mark:
